run_download_prepare_hf_data: run the CLI to download, shuffle, and split a HuggingFace dataset like fineweb_edu into chunked JSONL files
run_download_dataset: run the download_dataset function to download a HuggingFace dataset with retry logic on timeout
run_parquet_to_jsonl: run the parquet_to_jsonl function to convert Parquet files to JSONL using a DataTrove pipeline
run_setup_terashuf: run the setup_terashuf function to clone and compile the terashuf shuffling tool from source
run_run_command: run the run_command function to execute a shell command with subprocess and print the command being run
